== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Restraining Bolt (Dark) (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Restraining Bolt (Dark)]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100702 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100702], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100702-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>8ed4350ad0c787f771a1b6d25639202352b822a6499f6762a098b8c313f90c09</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
